comparison_seed.source: Danish EU-residence regulation and official guidance used as the comparison seed
comparison_seed.relationship_note: Latvia Law 369282 has a close functional relationship to the Danish EU free-movement residence source because it directly governs EU/EEA/Swiss citizens, non-EU family members and mobile Latvian citizens. It is not asserted to be legally equivalent. The EEA and Swiss route basis and UK Withdrawal Agreement beneficiaries remain explicit; Latvia’s third-country Immigration Law is a separate legal regime.

previous_findings_carried_forward: The Denmark-to-Sweden/Finland discovery smoke is a comparison lead, not proof of Latvian equivalence. Denmark remains the seed; Latvia is assessed at its own first-party publishers.

Use earlier country findings as search and adapter lessons only: Czechia shows API-registration friction can warrant an official stable-document workaround; Estonia, Finland, France and Germany show structured routes still require live/version/reuse validation.
Carry taxonomy gaps forward and search legislation, authority guidance, forms, consular practice, administrative procedure, file access, remedies, privacy, oversight, legal aid and courts separately.
Greece and Hungary findings show publisher terms and access conditions must be checked per exact publisher and endpoint; do not transfer another country’s reuse conclusion to Latvia.
N-Lex is a national-law discovery aid only. Verify the candidate at Latvijas Vēstnesis, Likumi.lv, the responsible ministry/authority or the court.
